name: AgentEnv Framework
summary: Scale AI's open-source Python SDK and CLI for building, deploying and scoring containerized agent environments and tasks for RL and evals.
description: Environments are containerized servers speaking the open `agentenv-framework-protocol`; the framework builds them into versioned images, deploys them behind a gateway, points an agent at them over MCP, REST or a generated CLI, and grades what the agent did. Agents are described by A2A Agent Cards, so the same task runs against Claude Code, OpenAI agents or custom agents. Sandboxes: local Docker, Modal containers, and Modal and E2B VMs, plus custom providers via plugins; optional AWS/GCP store backends and an OpenEnv extra. Try it with `uvx --from agentenv-framework agent-env run hello`. Requires Python 3.11.4+; PyPI `agentenv-framework` 0.9.1364. Scale says every RL environment it builds runs on AgentEnv.
